internal_ai_spot_check.source: Aggregate counts from an internal AI-assisted development review. Raters were AI systems, not humans. Item-level labels are unavailable. Not used as evidence in the paper.

insync.scope: Only repository-by-form strata containing both artefacts contribute.

open.scope: Only repository-by-form strata containing both artefacts contribute.

presence_spells.definition: A new spell starts after an evaluated snapshot in which the key is absent. Each spell is anchored only if valid at re-entry. As in the original estimator, exposure uses valid-start intervals between consecutive observations of the key, now restricted to one spell; no absent gap is bridged. Events hidden between sampled snapshots remain unobserved.

alarm_burden.definition: One alert per anchored context break episode across each observed repository window, including zeros. No deduplication by commit and no inferred false-alarm rate.
